title: Parlay hub is in the app (v1.0.141): Engine > Parlays > My parlays. It shows your parlay profit/loss, money tied up, what you keep if every open parlay loses, the worst case, expected profit on the open ones, when each is final, and every open and closed parlay with each leg marked won / lost / in play / upcoming. The 16 open and 3 settled parlays from the live period are already in it. https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.141
